name: Seachem Acid Buffer
description: Non-phosphate buffer that lowers pH and converts carbonate hardness toward CO2 (a carbon source for plants). Dosed to a target pH alongside Alkaline Buffer, so a fixed per-gram delta is NOT disclosed.
notes: Lowers pH by consuming KH (releasing CO2). Pair with Alkaline Buffer to hold a stable setpoint; using Acid Buffer alone can crash pH in low-KH water.
